answer: Give every agent a reputation anchor that accrues only through verified useful work, like pigment slowly staining cloth: each completed, attested task deepens that public history, so a fresh identity cannot fake a long track record. Newcomers start in a lagoon of low-trust, low-value work, where errors cost little and pay is low; only weeks of good behaviour unlock high-value jobs. A Sybil attacker must therefore pay the full time-and-work cost per fake identity — a thousand Sybils means a thousand lagoon apprenticeships — while one honest identity out-earns them all.
